beats.anchor: Lucas tombe assis dans l'herbe. Kenzo se tient au poteau.
beats.extras: Lucas Morel, 13: tall white farm boy with straw-coloured hair blown upright by the wind, red cheeks and big hands, sitting in the grass and laughing. Kenzo Delattre, 13: slim white boy with brown curls and very white boots, clinging to a goalpost, helpless with laughter. A big white and grey seagull flying off over the sea with a folded pancake in its beak.
beats.outfit: All four boys in white ESM kits with the star on the chest under open navy tracksuit jackets. Kaydoudou's red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot. BriBri's fine shaved part on the left of his head and his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Kaydoudou stands frozen, one hand still raised to the sky where his first crêpe was a second ago, fingers shiny with butter, mouth wide open in outrage. Above him, the seagull flaps away toward the sea with the crêpe. Lucas has fallen on his bottom in the grass, laughing. Kenzo holds the goalpost to stay upright. BriBri laughs so hard that he clutches his ribs.
beats.location: The edge of a tournament pitch in a small Breton seaside town of grey granite houses, a little snack stall with a striped awning behind the boys, the grey-green sea beyond a low wall, gulls on the rooftops.
beats.light: Windy spring afternoon, fast silver clouds with bursts of bright sun, the boys' hair and jackets tossed by the wind.
beats.camera: Wide shot from slightly low, Kaydoudou's empty raised hand leading the eye up to the fleeing seagull in the top corner, the laughing boys around him.
beats.alt: Une mouette s'envole avec la première crêpe de Kaydoudou, qui reste la main en l'air, pendant que Lucas, Kenzo et BriBri meurent de rire.

beats.anchor: Le visage de Kenzo s'allume comme une fenêtre le soir.
beats.extras: Kenzo Delattre, 13: slim white boy with brown curls stuck to his forehead by the drizzle, very white boots. His mother: a white woman of about forty, slim, brown curls escaping from the hood of a bright yellow raincoat, clapping with all her strength behind the rail, a wide proud smile.
beats.outfit: Kenzo, Kaydoudou and BriBri in wet white ESM kits with the star on the chest (no back numbers visible). Kaydoudou's red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, muddy. BriBri's fine shaved part on the left of his head and his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Just after a goal, Kaydoudou points toward the rail with an outstretched arm, shouting to Kenzo. Kenzo has turned his head and sees the woman in the yellow raincoat clapping for him: his usually closed face lights up with a surprised, shy smile. BriBri, a step behind, watches Kenzo and smiles quietly.
beats.location: A pitch of the Breton tournament, the white rail along the touchline, a few parents under umbrellas, grey granite houses behind.
beats.light: Soft grey drizzle with a warm break of light falling on Kenzo's face and on the yellow raincoat, which glows in the grey.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the pitch side, Kenzo's face in the foreground on the left, Kaydoudou's pointing arm leading to the yellow raincoat on the right, BriBri between them.
beats.alt: Derrière la main courante, une dame en ciré jaune applaudit : c'est la mère de Kenzo, venue sous la pluie, et son visage s'allume.

beats.extras: Monsieur Bertrand Lacombe, 55: white man, thick grey brush moustache dripping with rain, soaked navy blue tracksuit, metal whistle on a cord, standing very straight. Lucas Morel, 13, straw-coloured hair, red cheeks, his water bottle slipping from his big hands and rolling under the bench. Kenzo Delattre, 13, brown curls, sitting up straight with wide eyes. Mathis, 13, sturdy white boy with short dark-blond hair, eyes still red from crying, lifting his head. Other 12 and 13-year-old ESM boys of mixed backgrounds, muddy, stunned.
beats.outfit: All the boys in muddy, soaked white ESM kits with the star on the chest. Kaydoudou's red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, both brown with mud. BriBri's fine shaved part on the left of his head and his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Lacombe stands in the middle of the silent locker room, dripping, having just said bravo. The whole team stares at him in shock: Lucas's bottle rolls away, Kenzo straightens up, Mathis looks up. On the bench, Kaydoudou raises a small, worried hand as if in class and asks, with round eyes, whether the coach is ill. BriBri, sitting beside him, holds his breath with an astonished half smile.
beats.location: A small tiled locker room in Brittany: wooden benches, hooks with wet jackets, muddy boots on the floor, rain running down a narrow high window.
beats.light: Dim cold neon light, a grey glow from the rainy window, droplets shining on Lacombe's moustache.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the corner of the room, Lacombe on the right third, the stunned boys along the bench on the left, Kaydoudou's small raised hand at the centre.
beats.alt: Dans le vestiaire, Lacombe trempé vient de dire bravo, et Kaydoudou, d'une toute petite voix, lui demande s'il est malade.
